sections.heading: Phase-shift generation
sections.text: Generate the phase-shift command as a timer compare value, not a duty-cycle register. Phase-shift resolution must be fine enough for smooth power control — at least 10 bits over the 0-to-pi range. Coarse resolution causes quantization-induced oscillation.

sections.heading: Transformer current sensing
sections.text: For current-mode control of DAB, sense the transformer series inductor current (not the output current). The inductor current is the actual control-relevant signal. Use a current transformer or sense resistor in the primary path.

sections.heading: Bidirectional handover
sections.text: When the power reference crosses zero, the phase-shift command must cross zero smoothly. Implement anti-windup that resets the integrator when the phase-shift command crosses zero. A small dead-band around phi=0 prevents chattering.
